sections.title: Introduction
sections.body: Overview of the Safety Folder — its purpose, scope, how it should be used, and who is responsible for keeping it current.

sections.title: Safety Roles, Responsibilities and Authority
sections.body: Defines who is responsible for safety at the centre, their level of authority, and the escalation path when incidents or concerns arise.

sections.title: Risk Management
sections.body: The centre's approach to identifying, assessing, treating, and monitoring risks across all facilities, programmes, and operations.

sections.title: Operational Safety Checks
sections.body: Daily and periodic safety checks required before, during, and after operations — including facility inspections, equipment checks, and opening procedures.

sections.title: Sport Activity and Facility Safety
sections.body: Safety requirements specific to each sport and facility area — covering participant ratios, equipment standards, and activity-specific risk controls.

sections.title: Environmental and Weather Safety
sections.body: Protocols for managing weather-related and environmental risks, including lightning suspension procedures, heat management, and flooding response.

sections.title: Emergency and Incident Management
sections.body: Emergency response plans and incident reporting procedures — covering evacuation, first aid activation, escalation, and post-incident review.

sections.title: Monitoring, Review and Improvement
sections.body: How safety performance is tracked, reviewed, and improved — including KPI monitoring, audit schedules, and the corrective action process.

annexes.label: A
annexes.title: Centre Profile and Operating Context
annexes.body: Description of the centre — facilities, programmes offered, operating hours, and the key context that shapes its safety requirements.

annexes.label: B
annexes.title: Safety Appointments and Contact List
annexes.body: Named safety appointments at the centre — Safety Officer, First Aiders, Emergency Wardens — and their contact details.

annexes.label: C
annexes.title: Centre Risk Profile and Risk Register
annexes.body: The live risk register for the centre — identified hazards, risk ratings, controls in place, and responsible owners.

annexes.label: D
annexes.title: Operational Safety Checklists and Inspection Schedule
annexes.body: Completed operational safety checklists and the schedule for recurring facility inspections — maintained as an auditable record.

annexes.label: E
annexes.title: Sport Facility Safety Checklist
annexes.body: Pre-use safety checklist for each sport facility — courts, fields, pools, gyms — to be completed before activities commence.

annexes.label: F
annexes.title: Sport Activity / Programme / Event Safety Checklist
annexes.body: Activity-level safety checklist covering participant briefings, equipment checks, and coach/instructor readiness for each programme or event.

annexes.label: G
annexes.title: Environmental and Weather Safety Plan
annexes.body: The centre's documented plan for monitoring and responding to environmental and weather hazards, including decision thresholds and suspension criteria.

annexes.label: H
annexes.title: Emergency and Incident Management Plan
annexes.body: The centre's emergency response plan — covering fire, medical, security, and environmental emergencies — with roles, actions, and contact trees.

annexes.label: I
annexes.title: Safety Monitoring and Review Register
annexes.body: Record of safety audits, inspection outcomes, incidents, corrective actions taken, and lessons learned — the centre's continuous improvement log.
